note: This file is an MMDetection configuration file containing only variable assignments (dicts and lists). It has no callable functions, classes, or methods. It defines model architecture parameters, a training data augmentation pipeline, and dataloader settings for RTMDet instance segmentation with a tiny CSPNeXt backbone on COCO.
summarize_config: summarize the rtmdet tiny instance segmentation config file for model architecture and training pipeline
review_model_backbone: review the rtmdet tiny backbone configuration with deepen factor 0.167 and widen factor 0.375
review_train_pipeline: review the training pipeline with CachedMosaic, RandomResize, RandomCrop, and CachedMixUp augmentations
review_neck_config: review the neck configuration with in_channels 96 192 384 and out_channels 96
review_bbox_head: review the bbox_head configuration with in_channels and feat_channels set to 96
